name: lodash-chain-lazy-needs-value-jscomplexity-threshold
behavioral_change: lodash 3.0.0 made chaining lazy: operations on an explicit `_.chain()` sequence are no longer executed segment by segment but deferred until `_#value` is called implicitly or explicitly. Method names, arity and call forms are unchanged and no exception is raised.
downstream_effect: The downstream project (grunt-jscomplexity-threshold) runs `_.chain(scanReports).sortBy('complexity').reverse().each(...)` in `tasks/util/render.js` without a terminating `.value()`, so after the upgrade the `each` callback (which calls `reporter.add`) never executes and `reporter.render()` returns an empty result. The three failures are assertions such as `expected [] to deeply equal [ 120 ]`; the only production frame is `render.js:32` (`return reporter.render();`), not the chain at lines 12 to 30, and lodash is never named.
reference_fix: The reference fix edits only `tasks/util/render.js`, appending `.value();` to the end of the `_.chain` sequence.
documented_in: The lodash Changelog v3.0.0 (https://github.com/lodash/lodash/wiki/Changelog), section Compatibility Warnings, states that chaining was made lazy and execution is deferred until `_#value` is called. Tier 2: the change is declared in prose only, with no old versus new code.
failing_tests: test/tasks/util/render.test.coffee :: the render module should pass and ordered by complexity decreasing array to reporter
test/tasks/util/render.test.coffee :: the render module should exclude incomplete items passed in array
test/tasks/util/render.test.coffee :: the render module should add <path>, <complexity>, <maintainability>, <lineNumber> and <isThresholdPassed> properties to reporter from passed array
